newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO rejects joint stand on aid, Israel says.
newsitem.headline: PLO rejects joint stand on aid, Israel says.

text.p: The Palestinian Authority rejected an Israeli proposal to present a joint position to the conference of donor countries which opens on Thursday in Washington, Israeli Finance Minister Dan Meridor said.

In remarks broadcast on Israel Radio, Meridor said that at a recent meeting with Palestinian Minister of Economy and Trade Maher Al-Masri he proposed the two sides present a joint position to the donor countries but was "surprised" to receive a negative answer a day later.
He did not specify details of his proposed position.
"I said let's take a joint package to Washington and then the next day I got an answer that it wouldn't work out," Meridor said.

The conference of donor countries will discuss ways to relieve Palestinian budgetary problems and the creation of jobs. Thursday's meeting is part of a series that convenes every six months in Washington and Paris.
